macro.text: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 5.17% as traders weighed a hot producer price report
Oil markets head toward a surplus as global supply outpaces demand for the first time since the Iran war
Bitcoin fell below $69,000 as investors reposition cash for a blockbuster AI startup IPO
A Trump official sought $50 billion for air traffic control after Friday's nationwide FAA outage
The White House won't raise a tech executive's espionage scandal during Trump's upcoming China trip
A Fed survey flagged AI as the biggest emerging risk to the financial system

corporate.note: CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid an affair scandal involving an alleged Chinese spy, extending a six-week losing streak that erased roughly $1.7 trillion in market value
Chip stocks slid as Wall Street reassesses AI trade exposure now that Nvidia has lost its longtime CEO
Goldman is co-leading Anthropic's IPO while also pursuing wealth-management mandates from the windfall it creates for insiders
Director Carl Icahn sold $33.7 million of stock, one of several large insider sales disclosed this week
CEO William Lansing sold roughly $15 million in stock across two separate filings
Chief legal officer Ryan Pardo sold $40.8 million in common stock, a sizable insider disposal
A director bought $2.01 million in common stock, a notable insider purchase against the market's weak tone

frontPage.watch: Watch chipmakers for further AI-trade unwind following Nvidia's leadership shock and yields after the hot PPI print.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3739 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.840 + 0.971×ln(VIX) + 0.314×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
